root_device.description: The block device, UUID, or LABEL for the root filesystem.

root_mountpoint.description: The mount point for the root filesystem.

root_type.description: The filesystem type of the root partition.

root_options.description: Mount options for the root filesystem. 'errors=remount-ro' is a common safe default for ext2/3/4.

filesystems.description: A list of additional filesystem entries to include in fstab. Items must have keys: description, device, mountpoint, fstype, options, dump, passno. See items schema for details.

filesystems_items.description: Schema for each item in the filesystems list. Note: 'items' in the top-level schema references this flat map structure where keys are field names and values are type schemas.
